summary.text: Lisa Reynolds is a Democratic state senator from Oregon Senate District 17 who took office in December 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A pediatrician by profession, she previously served in the Oregon House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: Lisa Reynolds was born in Park Forest, Illinois, and earned an undergraduate degree from the University of Chicago in 1986 and an M.D. from the UCLA School of Medicine in 1991.

Her career experience includes working as a pediatrician with The Children's Clinic, as a pediatric resident at Harbor-UCLA Medical Center, and as chief resident in pediatrics at Randall Children's Hospital in Portland.
She co-founded Indivisible Oregon and has been a member of Moms Demand Action for Gun Sense, the Oregon Pediatric Society and the American Academy of Pediatrics.
Reynolds previously represented Oregon House District 36 and was appointed to the Senate seat previously held by Elizabeth Steiner Hayward, assuming office on December 9, 2024.
In the 2023-2024 House session, she chaired the Early Childhood Committee and served on the Judiciary Committee.
In an earlier Ballotpedia survey, she listed healthcare for all, mental health services, gun violence prevention, affordable housing and action on the climate crisis as her priorities.
